messages.subject: Re: SFLWR3: shameless self-promotion
messages.body_plain: Mark your calendars: Printing has begun (the book will have approx 496 pages) and De Gruyter has just confirmed the publication date of the printed version: 10 May 2021. And now no more shameless self-promotion, over and out!
